paragraphs: I’ve always been driven by the challenge of building tools that empower people. My journey in software is rooted in a product-first mindset: the belief that code only matters when it solves a genuine problem. Whether it's crafting a seamless user interface or architecting the data flow beneath it, I focus on building features that take the complexity out of the user's hands.

Currently, at Vyapar, I'm a Frontend Engineer dedicated to the desktop ecosystem. I build robust billing and invoicing software designed for the backbone of the economy—retail and mid-tier shop owners. In this space, software isn't just a utility; it's a lifeline. I develop high-performance desktop components where reliability is non-negotiable, ensuring that every invoice generated and every transaction recorded is backed by a rock-solid local architecture using SQLite.

Whether I'm optimizing the speed of a desktop application or refining the precision of a financial dashboard, my goal remains the same: to bridge the gap between complex system engineering and intuitive user experience. I thrive on the discipline of modern frontend craftsmanship, ensuring that even the most feature-rich tools feel light, fast, and effortless for the people who rely on them every day.
